name: Guardian of the Light
detailed_description:
One day, waking up without memory, in the depths of the Ancient Forest, you begin your thorny path, exploring mysterious locations and eradicating evil spirits, helping those in need in their difficult life in the conditions of the chaos of the Shadows.

You are one of the few who has the gift of not only resisting darkness, but also transforming its essence, turning destructive forces into creative energy!

Explore a vast universe, where each region tells its own story: from toxic swamps, where crystal gardens break through clouds of all-consuming fog, to majestic floating islands whose ancient technologies are waiting to be restored. Meet unique creatures and characters - from wise elders to lost souls, each of whom will tell you their own story.

The game mechanics include not only exploration, but also elements of strategy and role-playing development. You will have to choose a side in the conflict between light and darkness, develop your skills and abilities, and collect artifacts that will help you in the fight against powerful enemies

Each biome offers new puzzles and challenges that require both logical thinking and courage. The game is full of unexpected plot twists and moral dilemmas that make you think about what it means to be a hero in a world where good and evil are not always clearly defined?

Develop in different directions - become a Craftsman creating new realities. A healer reviving dying lands, a Peacemaker uniting disparate communities. A warrior cleansing contaminated lands from the forces of Darkness. Each path opens up unique abilities and approaches to transforming the world.

Join this exciting journey, where your fate depends on your decisions, and every step brings you closer to solving the greatest mystery - the true nature of light and darkness. Can you find the balance between these forces and become the one who changes the world?

short_description: In a World split by the confrontation between Light and Darkness, where Ancient Civilizations left behind Ruins of once great cities. You are a warrior of Light! The last ray of hope! The Future of this Magical World depends on you!
supported_languages:
English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Arabic*, Simplified Chinese*, Polish*, Russian*, Turkish*, Hindi*, Japanese*
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050Ti 4GB or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 32 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes:
Violence; Throughout the game, the player will kill enemy heroes, monsters, and possibly animals. At the scene of the murder, there will be corpses (rag doll) and a black liquid similar to blood until they disappear after a while. Whether to display this or not can be specified in the settings.
Nudity: a woman in a swimsuit or a man with a naked torso is the most you can see in this game.
